Lina CS: AcornHealth just sent a vendor risk form — main asks: embeddings retention policy, whether we store raw prompt text, and if BYOK is supported. They also want the ability to request tenant-scoped retention or on-demand deletion. Anyone got a quick take?
Priya AM: pinging @Omar Sec and @Jordan Platform for security/platform specifics. Customer may escalate for renewal if we can't commit.
Omar Sec: TL;DR: Hosted API retains vectors for analytics by default (we currently surface 30 days in infra). We DO offer BYOK but only with Private deployments right now (VPC/on-prem with customer-managed KMS). Hosted per-tenant retention config is not a product feature today.
Lina CS: customer preference is Hosted (self-serve), but they'd accept Hosted only with a 7-day retention max and a written commitment in the DPA addendum. They also asked whether we ever keep raw text that produced the embedding.
Omar Sec: we don't persist full raw text in the embeddings index by default — we persist vectors + minimal metadata (e.g., tenant id). If raw text is logged for debugging, it's scrubbed/ephemeral and covered by access controls. Recommend we clarify this in the DPA.
Priya AM: can we offer a Hosted short-term retention SLA as a one-off? That would reduce renewal risk.
security-bot: Note: BYOK (Private) integrates with customer KMS, keys never leave customer control; audit logs available. See internal BYOK spec: https://redwood.internal/security/byok (internal link).
Omar Sec: Operational workaround for Hosted: implement a scheduled purge job that deletes vectors older than N days and expose an admin purge API for on-demand deletion. Example ingestion snippet customers use: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"embed-1","input":"<text>","meta":{"tenant":"acorn-123"}}'``` Purge would target tenant index rows by timestamp.
Jordan Platform: @Lina CS @Priya AM I can scope this. Rough estimate: 2w to ship scheduled purge + admin purge endpoint (tests + small infra change) if we prioritize. Depends on index backend (FAISS + s3 snapshots) — need a quick infra review.
Lina CS: Great — I'll propose this plan to AcornHealth: 1) Hosted with 7-day retention commitment (transitional), 2) BYOK only on Private with KMS + audit logs, 3) Roadmap item to add tenant-scoped retention + admin purge API, 4) Draft DPA addendum language for embeddings.
Priya AM: please also ask Legal to pre-approve the addendum language — they often tweak the phrasing on retention windows. We should avoid promising per-tenant config until Platform confirms roadmap.
Omar Sec: Suggested DPA clause draft (for Lina to paste): "Redwood will retain embeddings derived from Customer-provided content for no longer than 7 days in Hosted deployments, unless Customer elects a Private deployment with BYOK, in which case embeddings retention is governed by Customer's storage practices and Redwood does not retain production embeddings."
Lina CS: I'll draft the DPA addendum now and post it here for review. Also tagging @DevOps (platform) to start the infra spike. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
